title: Biohydrogen production from Euglena acus microalgae available in Bangladesh
author: Mustafi, Hossain, et al.

steps.title: Isolate Euglena acus cells
steps.instruction: Isolate a single cell of Euglena acus from a sample using a micropipette under a microscope through repeated trial and error.

substeps.instruction: Transfer single cells to sterile droplets of water.
Add one drop of Euglena acus microalgae sample to several drops of sterile RO water placed in the groove of a glass slide.
Confirm the target species via microscopic observation and relevant literature.
Repeat the procedure to perform microalgae washing and isolate cells in pure form.

steps.title: Prepare sulfur-rich TAP (TAP+S) stock solutions
steps.instruction: Prepare the following analytical grade stock solutions for the sulfur-rich medium:

substeps.instruction: TAP Salt: Dissolve 15±1g Ammonium chloride, 4±1g Magnesium sulfate heptahydrate, and 2±0.5g Calcium chloride dihydrate in 850 ml distilled water; top up to 1L.
Phosphate Solution: Dissolve 29±1g Dipotassium phosphate and 15±1g Monopotassium phosphate in 70 ml distilled water; top up to 100 ml.
Hunter's Trace Element: Dissolve 5±1g EDTA in 25 ml distilled water; top up to 1L.

Prepare individual trace element solutions: Zinc sulfate heptahydrate (2±0.5g in 10 ml), Boric acid (1.5±0.5g in 20 ml), Manganese(II) chloride tetrahydrate (0.5±0.1g in 5 ml), Cobalt(II) chloride hexahydrate (0.15±0.01g in 5 ml), Copper sulfate pentahydrate (0.15±0.02g in 5 ml), Ammonium molybdate (0.1±0.01g in 5 ml), and Ferrous sulfate heptahydrate (0.5±0.1g in 5 ml).

steps.title: Prepare sulfur-free TAP (TAP-S) stock solutions
steps.instruction: Prepare the following analytical grade stock solutions for the sulfur-free medium, replacing sulfur salts with equimolar chloride salts:

substeps.instruction: TAP Salt: Dissolve 15±1g Ammonium chloride, 4±1.0g Magnesium chloride monohydrate, and 2±0.5g Calcium chloride dihydrate in 850 ml distilled water; top up to 1L.
Phosphate Solution: Dissolve 29±1g Dipotassium phosphate and 15±1g Monopotassium phosphate in 70 ml distilled water; top up to 100 ml.
Hunter's Trace Element: Dissolve 5±1g EDTA in 25 ml distilled water; top up to 1L.

Prepare individual trace element solutions: Zinc chloride (1±0.5g in 10 ml), Boric acid (1.5±0.5g in 20 ml), Manganese(II) chloride tetrahydrate (0.5±0.1g in 5 ml), Cobalt(II) chloride hexahydrate (0.15±0.01g in 5 ml), Copper(II) chloride dihydrate (0.1±0.01g in 5 ml), Ammonium molybdate (0.11±0.01g in 5 ml), and Ferrous chloride tetrahydrate (0.35±0.01g in 5 ml).

steps.title: Mix TAP+S growth medium
steps.instruction: Prepare the final sulfur-rich TAP medium for algal biomass cultivation.

substeps.instruction: Mix 2.42 g of Tris, 25 ml of TAP salt stock, 0.375 ml of phosphate solution, 1.0 ml Hutner's Trace element, and 1.0 ml of glacial acetic acid with 600 ml distilled water.
Dissolve all ingredients and add additional water to reach a final volume of one liter.

steps.title: Mix TAP-S production medium
steps.instruction: Prepare the sulfur-free TAP medium for H2 production following the same mixing method as the TAP+S medium, substituting the sulfur-rich stock solutions with the sulfur-free stock solutions.

steps.title: Cultivate algal biomass
steps.instruction: Cultivate Euglena acus cells in the sulfur-rich (TAP+S) medium to boost photosynthesis and enhance the algal growth rate.

steps.title: Induce biohydrogen production
steps.instruction: Transfer the grown algae cells to a sealed container or reactor containing the sulfur-deprived (TAP-S) medium.

substeps.instruction: Allow the cells to become anaerobic (typically within ~24 hours) as the O2 production rate falls below the respiration consumption rate.
Maintain O2 content at a low level (<0.1%) to sustain H2 yield.
